quotes.author: Highlight of OBX Vacation
quotes.text: This was a highlight of our OBX vacation! It took about 30 minutes to locate some dolphins, but suddenly they were all around! We sat at the front of the boat and would have gotten soaked...
Great tour of the sound from the Captain and his mate. We went out Friday morning the 5th of August. We saw lots of dolphins, toured the sound and got a great education on the dolphins...

quotes.author: Excellent Time!
quotes.text: We saw lots of dolphins. The captain was very knowledgeable and made sure we saw the dolphins. He was very friendly. I enjoyed this cruise and this is made for friends and families.

quotes.author: Awesome Experience
quotes.text: Captain Jay never disappoints, we come to OBX every year and do his dolphin tour every time. Awesome experience every time!!!
